jobs_results.title: Salesforce Developer (Commerce Cloud)
jobs_results.description:
¿Eres Único, Creativo y Atrevido? ¡Eres lo que estamos buscando!

Si quieres unirte al equipo de una firma internacional en pleno crecimiento con más de 100 tiendas en todo el mundo, ¡esta es tu oportunidad! Únete al universo creativo de UNOde50, joyería de diseño hecha a mano en España.

UNOde50 está presente en más de 40 países, con tiendas en las calles más emblemáticas de grandes ciudades como París, Roma, Madrid, Londres, Milán, Barcelona, Nueva York, Tokyo, Moscú y Shanghái.

Buscamos un/a Salesforce Developer para el mantenimiento y administración de la plataforma que reportará directamente al Digital Business Director y formará parte de nuestro equipo en nuestras oficinas de Madrid.

Funciones:
• Desarrollo de evolutivos de la actual plataforma Salesforce Commerce Cloud
• Análisis de nuevos requisitos y funcionalidades del área de digital de la compañía
• Mantenimiento y administración de la actual plataforma Salesforce.
• Creación de documentación técnica.

Requisitos:
•... Experiencia de al menos 3 años como desarrollador Salesforce con experiencia en Commerce Cloud.
• Experiencia en administración y configuración de la plataforma Salesforce.
• Experiencia en análisis de requerimientos funcionales y definición.
• Experiencia en creación de documentación técnica.
• Certificación Salesforce Platform Developer I muy valorable.
• Deseable certificación en B2C Commerce Developer.
• Experiencia con catálogos, y diseño de PLP y PDP
• Experiencia en integraciones API y WebServices.
• Experiencia trabajando con Agile
• Conocimientos de HTML, CSS, JavaScript

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer
jobs_results.description:
Responsibilities:
• Develop dynamic enhanced e-commerce web experiences.
• Develop customer-specific web-based applications, systems integrations, and custom applications following the latest industry standards and best practices.
• Develop high-performance eCommerce experiences considering the latest digital trends.
• Apply technical skills in both front and back-end environments.
• Change/adapt code according to specifications.
• Take part in peer code review sessions.
• Actively participate and contribute to periodic team meetings with other developers, QA, PM, and BA.

Requirements:
• Strong JavaScript knowledge with a focus on the back-end stack and understanding of usage in the front-end architecture.
• Previous experience in Salesforce Commerce Cloud implementations.
• Knowledge of Node.JS and React or Vue, tools like Webpack or Yarn would be a plus.
• Experience with MVC and architecture.
• Good knowledge of Github and Github actions would be a plus.
• Experience in... integrating 3rd party systems using SOAP/REST Web Services.
• Fluency in English and Spanish.

• Fluency in English and Spanish

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs_results.description:
Omega CRM is a Merkle & Dentsu company, leader in development of Customer Experience services, with +20 years of experience in the use of Technology applied to Marketing and providing a unique Customer Relationship with mainly focus on Innovation is looking for a Salesforce Developer.

Main responsabilities:
• Develop software according to user requirements, functional and technical design specifications.
• Perform and assist with quality assurance activities as needed.
• Asses, troubleshoot, document, upgrade and develop maintenance procedures.
• Review code for potential performance issues, reusability and/ or anomalies.

Mandatory Skills:
• At least 2+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
• Experience in developing complex solutions on Sales in Salesforce
• Experience in developing lightning components desired.
• Development technologies (APEX, Visualforce, migration tools, SOQL, web services).
• Understanding of both DevOps/Agile (SCRUM) and Waterfall delivery principles... and the importance of SDLC (Software Development Process) and coding methodology principles is a plus
• Should be able to work in a self managing way and should take Accountability of all assigned applications
• Excellent spoken and written English.
• Experience working in an international and intercultural environment and availability to travel.
• Salesforce Platform Developer I certification is a must.
• Any other Salesforce certification is a plus

What Do We Offer
• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
• Trainings & Certifications. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
• Home Office.
• Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurant, …).
• Health insurance.
• OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention.

About Us

We are a digital global company whose mission is to accelerate the business experience (BX) of its customers. In concrete terms, our 360 solutions allow business transformation and acceleration by means of technology and data applied to Customer #OmnichannelExperiences in fields such as #CustomerServices, #eCommerce, #Analytics or #Marketing. We target companies from different fields such as: #Retail, , #Manufacturing but also #Education, #NonProfit, #NGO etc. We are one of the top 3 partners of #Salesforce in Europe. Our team is composed of more than 450 people of 24 nationalities based in Spain and France, who have wide knowledge and experience that understands business processes and technology while enjoying what it does. Key to our success is the knowledge of our people. We are an innovation and Outstanding Knowledge award-winning, Salesforce Consulting Partner. Our priority is the well-being of the team. We foster a collaborative culture, involved and supported by our company values: #Talent, #flexibility, #commitment and #innovation. We bring them to everything we do. #TogetherWeGrow

jobs_results.title: Technical Lead Salesforce
jobs_results.description:
Desde Serem nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Technical Lead Salesforce para importante cliente.

Funciones:

Liderara la estrategia de testing, definira KPI´s y elaborara reportes

· Tecnologías obligatorias: SALESFORCE, CONFLUENCE JIRA

· Tecnologías deseables: Experiencia en banca.

Inglés Alto.

Modalidad de trabajo 100% remoto con reunión puntual en el cliente.

Fomentamos un ambiente de trabajo multicultural e inclusivo, no discriminamos por edad, género o creencias; así como ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades a todo el personal.

Desarrollamos nuestras actividades bajo los principios del cuidado del medioambiente, la sostenibilidad y la responsabilidad social corporativa; colaborando en proyectos de reforestación y sostenibilidad.

Apoyamos los 10 principios del Pacto Mundial y los 17 Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible, en materia de derechos humanos, condiciones laborales, medio ambiente y anticorrupción.

Los procesos de reclutamiento se desarrollan bajo altos estándares... de calidad definiendo la incorporación en base a la experiencia y habilidades del candidato.

Somos una empresa española líder en servicios tecnológicos y atracción del talento presente en el mercado desde 1995. Contamos con más de 600 empleados en proyectos tanto nacionales como internacionales en sector TI

jobs_results.description:
Omega CRM is a Merkle & Dentsu company, leader in development of Customer Experience services, with +20 years of experience in the use of Technology applied to Marketing and providing a unique Customer Relationship with mainly focus on Innovation is looking for a Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer

Main responsibilities:
• Participate in analysis for marketing automation and martech solution development.
• Participate in the implementation of marketing cloud development infrastructure.
• Participate in analyzing clients' specific marketing and technology needs and contribute to communication processes in systems by implementing developments.
• Perform basic technical and specialized marketing tasks.
• Implement and develop the necessary processes to run cloud-oriented marketing automation solutions.
• Launch developments and automation processes that best suit cloud implementation.
• Participate in development consulting services to ensure that automated communication processes run... smoothly.
• Implement the necessary developments to activate automated communications and marketing automation processes that meet clients' needs at different touchpoints with their contacts.
• Participate in implementing the latest technological advances and marketing technology solutions.
• Perform test trials, error diagnostics, and resolve development issues in the use of marketing automation and martech tools.
• Document development processes and track system performance metrics.
• Work on cloud integrations using different programming and development languages: Javascript, Ampscript, Server-Side Javascript, API.
• Meet the agreed-upon software quality standards with Omega's technical management.

Mandatory Skills:
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar role
• Proficiency in SQL, AMPscript, and JavaScript
• Experience in HTML and CSS development
• Salesforce certifications are an asset.

• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Project Manager - Product Owner
jobs_results.description:
Salesforce Project Manager - Product Owner

Neurored helps global businesses digitize their operations in the fast-paced world of Trade, Transportation, and Logistics; Neurored has developed the leading Transportation Management System (TMS) Software on Salesforce applications on the Salesforce AppExchange, becoming a reference partner of Salesforce worldwide

Sector: Technology

We have the need to incorporate talent to help us scale our operations. Our objective is to incorporate a Salesforce expert, with a Project Management profile who has experience in Logistics processes and systems, and who knows how to design processes to support projects with their clients

We are looking for a proactive profile, problem solver, results-oriented and with a focus on business analysis. If you have experience in the world of consulting, have studied a technical career (engineering or related field), are bilingual in English, manage advance Salesforce environment and are familiar with agile... methodologies, this challenge is perfect for you!

Responsibilities:

• Coordination and leadership of solution sales processes

• Customer relationship management
